maya: 2178901234 Hey team — noticed a production problem: smart-router fell back from r-xl-32k to r-small-4k in eu-west for an enterprise tenant, and the small variant doesn't support tool-calling. The client saw a cascade of 502s when trying to invoke tools. Repro steps below, wanted to sync quickly.

samir: 2178901250 Can you paste the minimal error/log and confirm this was Dedicated or Hosted?

maya: 2178901260 Hosted (enterprise-tenant on reserved capacity). Logs:
```
[2026-03-19T15:02:11Z] router: route(request_id=abcdef) tier=enterprise region=eu-west preferred_model=r-xl-32k fallback_to=r-small-4k
[2026-03-19T15:02:11Z] serving: model=r-small-4k capabilities={tokenizer:spm_v1, max_context:4096, tool_calling:false}
[2026-03-19T15:02:12Z] proxy: upstream returned 502 tool-invocation error: unsupported_capability: tool_calling
```

maya: 2178901265 Impact: a small percentage of requests (those hitting tools) failed across a single customer segment for ~17m before we detected. We lack a cheap pre-flight check in the router to avoid this.

jon: 2178901272 Ugh. This is the long-standing variant-capability gap. We currently only compare model IDs and max_seq heuristics. We need a compatibility "handshake" during routing that includes tokeniser and tool_calling flags.

lia: 2178901278 Agree. Also we should surface these mismatches in the Console (dashboards + alerts) so support sees customer-facing impact.

samir: 2178901286 Proposal: extend the internal route decision API response with a small capability mask for chosen variant, e.g. `cap_mask` integer + `max_context` int + `tokenizer_id` string. Router should verify required capabilities (tool_calling, structured_output, tokenizer parity) before finalizing route. If mismatch, either skip variant or run a graceful degrade path (error to client with clear message).

jon: 2178901289 I prefer avoiding string blobs in hot path. Suggest bitmask defs in model-registry and a tiny helper: 
```
# bit defs
TOOL_CALLING = 1 << 0
KV_CACHE = 1 << 1
TOKENIZER_SPM = 1 << 2
TOKENIZER_BPE = 1 << 3
MAX_CTX_8K = 1 << 4
```
Router gets mask and we do `if (mask & REQUIRED_MASK) != REQUIRED_MASK` -> consider incompatible. This keeps payload small and check cheap.

lia: 2178901292 Quotas: if we skip a preferred variant and route to a cheaper one, we should check token-cost implications and quota surface in Console (per-route projected cost). Otherwise customers get surprising bills or throttles. Add `estimated_unit_cost` to route metadata.

samir: 2178901295 Telemetry idea: emit a `router.fallback.mismatch` metric with tags: tier, region, requested_caps, served_caps, model_from, model_to, and increment a counter + histogram of time-to-detect. Hook that to a Console alert rule (rate threshold).

deploy-bot: 2178901296 deploy 2026-03-19T15:10:00: router/compat-check v0.1 -> staged to eu-west canary.

maya: 2178901298 Action items: @samir add capability mask check in router + estimated_unit_cost pre-check; @jon add bitfield defs + decode util (lib/model_registry); @lia add dashboard panels/alert + add to rollout checklist; I will write a short postmortem draft and add automated test in e2e for tool-call paths. Can we target PRs this week? :white_check_mark:

samir: 2178901299 ack — I'll open the router PR and include metric names and example log lines.
